events.description: Lecanemab (with Eisai) Clarity AD Phase 3 in early Alzheimer's met primary and all key secondary endpoints (announced 2022-09-27 after US close)
mRNA-4157/V940 + Keytruda met primary endpoint in Phase 2b KEYNOTE-942 adjuvant melanoma (44% reduction in recurrence/death risk), announced pre-market
Donanemab TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 2 Phase 3 in early Alzheimer's met primary endpoint, slowing decline ~35%, announced pre-market
Oral GLP-1 orforglipron ATTAIN-1 Phase 3 obesity: met endpoints but ~12.4% weight loss underwhelmed vs expectations; stock sold off hard
CagriSema REDEFINE-1 Phase 3 obesity: ~20.4% actual weight loss vs ~25% expected; ADR fell sharply (announced pre-US-market)
VK2735 (GLP-1/GIP) Phase 2 VENTURE obesity trial: up to 14.7% weight loss at 13 weeks, announced pre-market
Vutrisiran HELIOS-B Phase 3 in ATTR cardiomyopathy met primary and all secondary endpoints, announced pre-market
Resmetirom MAESTRO-NASH Phase 3 hit both liver-histology primary endpoints (first successful NASH Phase 3), announced pre-market
FDA accelerated approval of Rezdiffra (resmetirom), first NASH/MASH drug (approval announced 2024-03-14 after close)
Elevidys EMBARK Phase 3 DMD gene therapy missed primary endpoint (NSAA at 52 weeks); announced 2023-10-30 after close
FDA expanded Elevidys label to DMD ages 4+ incl. non-ambulatory (traditional + accelerated approval); announced 2024-06-20 after close
FDA PCNS advisory committee reconvened and voted 7-2 that AMX0035 (Relyvrio) evidence supports approval in ALS (vote 2022-09-07 evening)
Relyvrio/AMX0035 PHOENIX Phase 3 in ALS failed primary and secondary endpoints; drug later withdrawn from market
FDA ODAC voted 12-2 that imetelstat benefit/risk is favorable in lower-risk MDS (vote 2024-03-14; stock halted that day)
Ivonescimab HARMONi-2 Phase 3 (China): PFS superiority vs pembrolizumab in PD-L1+ NSCLC, presented at WCLC 2024-09-08 (Sunday)
Ivonescimab HARMONi Phase 3 (EGFRm NSCLC) met PFS but overall survival missed statistical significance
Aficamten SEQUOIA-HCM Phase 3 in obstructive HCM met primary endpoint (pVO2) and all 10 secondary endpoints, announced pre-market
Brensocatib ASPEN Phase 3 in bronchiectasis met primary endpoint (pulmonary exacerbation reduction), announced pre-market
Suzetrigine Phase 2 in painful lumbosacral radiculopathy showed no meaningful separation from placebo (2.02 vs 1.98 point NPRS reduction)
KarXT (xanomeline-trospium) EMERGENT-2 Phase 3 in schizophrenia met primary endpoint (-9.6 PANSS vs placebo), announced pre-market
Obefazimod ABTECT-1/-2 Phase 3 induction trials in ulcerative colitis met primary endpoint (announced 2025-07-22 after US close / pre-market 7-23)
FDA approved Auvelity (AXS-05, dextromethorphan-bupropion) for major depressive disorder, announced that morning
Apitegromab SAPPHIRE Phase 3 in spinal muscular atrophy met primary endpoint (HFMSE motor function), announced pre-market
AMT-130 pivotal Phase 1/2 Huntington's gene therapy: 75% slowing of progression (cUHDRS) vs external control at 36 months, announced pre-market
FDA accelerated approval of Amtagvi (lifileucel) TIL therapy for advanced melanoma (announced Fri 2024-02-16 after close; Mon holiday)
FDA PDAC voted 9-3 that evidence does not support pimavanserin efficacy in Alzheimer's disease psychosis (vote Fri 2022-06-17; Mon Juneteenth holiday)
Cibotercept (KER-012) Phase 2 TROPOS in PAH: 3.0/4.5 mg-kg arms halted after pericardial effusion safety findings, announced pre-market
Birtamimab AFFIRM-AL Phase 3 in Mayo Stage IV AL amyloidosis missed primary endpoint (all-cause mortality, p=0.768); program discontinued (announced Fri 2025-05-23; Mon Memorial Day)
FDA issued Complete Response Letter for deramiocel (CAP-1002) BLA in DMD cardiomyopathy, announced pre-market
FDA approved XPHOZAH (tenapanor) for hyperphosphatemia in CKD on dialysis (announced 2023-10-17 after close)
Efruxifermin Phase 2b SYMMETRY in compensated cirrhosis (F4) due to NASH missed week-36 primary endpoint, announced pre-market
Setrusumab (UX143) Phase 3 Orbit in osteogenesis imperfecta: second interim analysis did not reach early-stop efficacy threshold; study continues to final analysis (announced 2025-07-09 after close)
Partnered setrusumab (UX143) Phase 3 Orbit second interim analysis missed early-stop efficacy bar (same announcement as RARE; MREO holds royalty/milestone economics)
FDA Complete Response Letter for govorestat NDA in classic galactosemia (announced 2024-11-27 after close; Thanksgiving 11-28; crash printed Fri 11-29)
Pegozafermin ENLIVEN Phase 2b in NASH hit both primary histology endpoints with high statistical significance, announced pre-market
Seralutinib TORREY Phase 2 in PAH met PVR primary endpoint but 6-minute-walk secondary missed; market treated readout as a failure
Lumateperone (Caplyta) Study 501 Phase 3 as adjunctive therapy in MDD met primary endpoint (MADRS, p<0.0001), announced pre-market

params.exit: intrinsic at event-day close (time value forfeited)
